Emit a discovery result as a federation manifest

Source: R/manifest.R
as_orchestra_manifest.Rd

The federation's emit / adapt generic. The cd_result method turns a recovered graph into the shared orchestra_manifest contract: inferential_target = "structure", the recovered edges carried as a tidy params edge list, and the provenance – which method ran, the routing rationale, the routing confidence, and whether the result is a single method or a consensus – in the typed summary and metadata. The full adjacency matrix (and, for a consensus, the per-edge agreement) rides in metadata for a consumer that wants the matrix rather than the edge list. When no graph was recovered (an absent back-end), the manifest abstains and says so. The payload is integrity-hashed so a consumer can verify it with verify_manifest().

Usage

as_orchestra_manifest(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A cd_result.

...

Further arguments passed to methods. The cd_result method accepts run_id (an optional character run identifier; a content hash is derived when omitted, so two identical results get the same identifier) and seed (an optional integer recorded for reproducibility).

Value

An orchestra_manifest S7 object.

See also

verify_manifest(), cd_auto(), cd_discover()

Examples

g <- matrix(c(0, 0, 1, 0), 2, 2,
            dimnames = list(c("x1", "x2"), c("x1", "x2")))
as_orchestra_manifest(cd_result(graph = g, method = "demo",
                                method_name = "Demo", family = "constraint"))
